title: Layout Preview Index
description: Shape of previews/layouts/index.json in @openpresentation/gallery 2: one self-contained SVG preview per v2 intent layout, keyed by the matching catalog layout id. Each record names its SVG file and exact UTF-8 byte length. The gallery package owns the files; this checkout materializes ignored copies under packages/gallery/previews/layouts/. This internal index schema is excluded from the package's published/typed schema surface.

version.description: Index format version, as a string.

description.description: Human-readable description of the preview gallery and its rendering conventions.

records.description: One entry per v2 layout and its SVG preview.

id.description: The matching layout record id, such as cover, chart or two-column.

file.description: SVG filename, relative to this index directory, using the matching layout id.

bytes.description: Exact UTF-8 byte length of the referenced SVG file.
